verses.text: Ix sch'ox Jehová wil jun mo'och sat awb'en k'inhxo.

Ix sk'anb'an t'ayin icha tik: --¿Tas tzil chi' Amós? xchi t'ayin. --Ha jun mo'och sat awb'en k'inhxo swila', xin chi t'ay. Ix yalanxi t'ayin icha tik: --Ha Israel, ichawal to toxo ix k'inhb'i. Manhxo ol wak'xi niwank'olal.

Ayik ol wak'anoch syahelal heb' chi', a heb' ix ix sb'itan t'a spatil heb' yajal, ol ok' heb' ix yuj kusk'olal. Tzijtum anima ol chamok, ol kan teljab' sniwanil heb'. Malaj tas ol ab'chajok, xchi Jehová.
Scham he maklan eyab' juntzanh lolonel tik, mach ex tzeyixtej heb' emnakil yek'i yet' heb' meb'a' t'a chonhab' tik.

Tzeyalan t'a yoltak he pat t'a k'inh ayik tz'alji k'e'en uj: ¿B'ak'inh ol lajwok yek' jun k'inh tik yik syal ko chonhan ko trigo? ¿B'ak'inh ol lajwok yek' sk'uhal ik'oj ip, yik ol yal ko chonhanxi sat kawb'en, ol kak'lab'an echlab' manh tz'akanok, haxo stojol niwan ol ko k'ana'?

Ol ko chonhanpax sk'a'elal ixim trigo. Ol kixtej juntzanh heb' meb'a' tik, masanto ol yal schonhanel sb'a heb' t'ayonh, yik tz'och heb' ko chekab'ok. Icha chi' ol aj stupanel sb'ok heb' t'ayonh, wach'chom jab'nhej sb'ok heb' chi' icha stojol jun mojok xanhab', xe chi.
Yuj chi' ix yak' sti' Jehová sDiosal winhaj Jacob, ix yalan icha tik: Malaj b'ak'inh ol b'at he chukal satk'olal wu'uj, xchi.

Yuj chi' ol ib'xokk'e lum lum, ol ok' masanil heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um. Masanil jun chonhab' tik ol ib'xokk'ei, ol k'e lum t'a cha'anh, ol empax lu'um icha tz'aj ha' Nilo, sk'ib'k'e ha', stupxiem ha'.
Ha in Jehová in swal yuj jun k'uhal chi': T'a chimk'uhalil, ol wak'em k'u, ol och k'ik' k'inal t'a k'uhalil.

Ha in ol wak'och sk'uhal he k'inh t'a kusk'olal. Haxo he b'it yuj tzalajk'olal ol wak'och t'a ok'el yuj chamel. Haxo pichul yik kusk'olal ol eyak'ochi, ol he joxanel xil he jolom yuj he ch'oxanel he kusk'olal. Ol ex ok' icha junok mach tz'ok' yuj junok k'otanh yuninal ix chami. Kusk'olal ol aj slajwi masanil.
Ay wal jun k'uhal ol wak'kot wejel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Manh wejelok yuj wa'el, manh takinhtialok yuj ha ha', palta wejel yik tz'ab'chaj in lolonel. Ha in Jehová Syal Wuj Masanil, a in swala'.

Ha heb' anima, toxonhej ol b'eyek' heb' sayanek' mach tz'alan in lolonel. Ol b'at heb' t'a stitak ha' mar Muerto, masanto ol k'och heb' t'a stitak ha' mar Mediterráneo, ol ek'chaj heb' t'a schanhil pak'anh yol yib'anhk'inal, palta malaj mach ol ilchaj yuj heb'.
Ha t'a jun k'uhal chi', a heb' ix kob'estak te wach' yilji yet' heb' kelemtak te tek'an, ol el yip heb' yuj takinhtial.

Icha chi' ol aj heb' syak' sti' t'a juntzanh yechel k'ixwelaltak ay t'a Samaria, haton heb' tz'alan icha tik: Swak' in ti' t'a sb'i sdiosal heb' aj Dan, ma t'a sb'i sdiosal heb' aj Beerseba, xchi heb'. Yuj chi' manhxa b'ak'inh ol k'e wa'an heb', xchi Jehová.
